senses.gloss: A goddess worshipped by the Tāntrikas; also °मुखी.

a. Talkative. 
-ग्नुः [वच्-नुः गश्च [[Uṇ. 3. 33]]] 
__1 A speaker. 
__2 A sound. 
__3 A cry (of an animal &c).

__1 A sage, holy man. 
__2 A learned Brāhmaṇa, scholar. 
__3 A brave man, hero. 
__4 A touchstone, whet-stone. 
__5 An impediment, obstacle. 
__6 Certainty, determination. 
__7 Submarine fire. 
__8 A wolf. 
__9 A water-vessel; [[L. D. B.]] 
__10 A horse of the sun; [[L. D. B.]]
a. Breaking one's promises, perfidious, faithless.

[वा-हिंसने उरच् गन् च [[Uṇ. 1. 40]]] A trap, net, snare, toils, meshes; को वा दुर्जनवागुरासु पतितः क्षेमेण यातः पुमान् [[Pt. 1. 146.]] 
-Comp. 
-वृत्तिः f. livelihood obtained by catching wild animals. 
(-त्तिः) a fowler, huntsman; [[Ms. 10. 32.]]
A fowler, hunter, deer-catcher; श्वगणिबागुरिकैः प्रथमास्थितम् [[R. 9. 53.]]

a. [वाच् अस्त्यर्थे ग्मिनिः चस्य कः तस्य लोपः; cf. [[P. V. 2. 124]]] 
__1 Eloquent, oratorical. 
__2 Talkative. 
__3 Verbose, wordy. -m. 
__1 An orator, an eloquent man; अनिर्लोडितकार्यस्य बाग्जालं बाग्मिनो वृथा [[Śi. 2. 27]], 109; [[Ki. 14. 6]]; [[Pt. 3. 87.]] 
__2 N. of Bṛhaspati. 
__3 N. of Viṣṇu. 
__4 A parrot.

a. [वाचं यच्छति, यम्-ड] 
__1 Speaking little, speaking cautiously. 
__2 Speaking truly. 
-ग्यः 
__1 Modesty, humility. 
__2 Doubt, alternative.
